sentences.text: Standing in line takes a long time.
Standing strengthens the legs.
Standing on the bus is tiring.
Turning the key opens the door.
A turn to the left is necessary.
A quick turn causes dizziness.
A leaf's fall is in autumn.
Falling on ice is painful.
The fall of rain is heard on the roof.
Giving a gift brings joy.
Giving is a sign of generosity.
Giving bread helps a hungry person.
Holding a glass is done carefully.
Holding in the hand needs strength.
Holding a child must be safe.
Squeezing a lemon gives juice.
Squeezing by hand is simple.
Squeezing clothes removes water.
Rubbing the hands gives warmth.
Rubbing can irritate the skin.
Rubbing ointment is done slowly.
Washing clothes happens weekly.
Washing with soap is better.
Washing hands before eating is important.
Wiping the table leaves it clean.
Wiping with a damp cloth is quick.
Wiping the window makes it bright.
Pulling the door needs strength.
Pulling with a rope is easier.
Pulling a box on the floor is noisy.
Pushing the door opens it inward.
Pushing in a line is rude.
Pushing a bicycle uphill is hard.
Throwing a ball goes far.
Throwing into the bin keeps things tidy.
Throwing a stone into the river is heard.
Tying a rope makes a knot.
Tying is necessary on shoes.
Tying a box with tape is firm.
Sewing clothes takes time.

Sewing on a button is easy.
Counting apples is quick.

Counting money needs attention.
Saying the truth is important.

Saying thanks is a good habit.
Singing a song opens the heart.
Singing in a choir is more beautiful.
A child's singing fills the house.
Playing ball is in the yard.
Playing with friends is cheerful.
Evening playing is short.
A leaf's floating on water is slow.
Floating on the river is calm.
A boat's floating is a sway on the waves.
The flow of water in the river is fast.
Flow comes down from the mountain.
Slow flow is in the lake.
Freezing of water is in winter.
Freezing turns the lake to ice.
Quick freezing is in the freezer.
Swelling of the foot makes walking hard.
Swelling comes after an injury.
Swelling lessens with cold water.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun warms the room.
The sun hides behind a cloud.
The moon shines at night.
A full moon is large.
The moon moves slowly in the sky.
A bright star is in the sky.
A star is visible at night.
A small star is far away.
Clean water is in the jug.
Water comes from the river.
Cold water kills thirst.
Heavy rain beats on the roof.
Rain waters the garden.
In autumn rain is frequent.
A wide river flows slowly.
The river comes down from the mountain.
A bridge crosses the river.
A calm lake is between the mountains.
The lake is warm in summer.
Birds fly around the lake.
The sea stretches to the horizon.
The sea is restless in a storm.
Children play by the edge of the sea.
Salt flavors the soup.
Sea salt is coarse.
Salt is kept in a jar.
A round stone is on the road.
I could not lift the heavy stone.
A stone by the river is wet.
Soft sand is on the beach.
Sand warms the feet.
Warm sand stays on the beach.
Dry dust is on the shelves.
Dust spins in the air.
Opening the window raised dust.
Black earth is fertile.
Earth is soft after rain.
The farmer ploughs the earth.
A grey cloud covers the sky.
A cloud brings rain.
A white cloud moves slowly.
Thick fog covers the road.
In the morning fog is in the valley.
Fog clears slowly.
The blue sky is without clouds.
The sky turns red in the evening.
Birds cross the sky.
A strong wind shakes the trees.
Wind scatters the leaves.
A cold wind comes from the north.
White snow covers the roofs.
Snow falls softly.
Children gather snow.
Thick ice is on the lake.
Ice melts in the sun.
A foot slides on ice.
